name: Dayton
takeaway: Dayton's AES Ohio aggregation at 8.71¢ expired June 30, 2026. Accounts are now on AES Ohio standard supply (~10.691¢) — the biggest rate shock in the state.
hook: Dayton's aggregation expired June 30 — those accounts jumped from 8.71 to 10.69 cents with no contract. That's a 23% hit. Have they looked at anything?
notes: SOPEC (Sustainable Ohio Public Energy Council) contract: 8.71¢/kWh through June 2026, repricing to 10.691¢/kWh. AES Ohio (formerly Dayton Power & Light) territory. Highest near-term rate pain in the state.

name: Riverside

name: Troy
